Name: Craftable Terrarium
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Jealous of Sebastian's frog terrarium? Fancy yourself an amateur batrachiologist? Just like frogs?

This mod allows you to create your own terrarium complete with as many frogs as you like!

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7837]Lively Frog Sanctuary[/url]﻿ - it will overwrite this mod's sprite with that mod's. It is also compatible with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5041]Frogs to Turtles[/url] and you can remove the croak sound in the config by setting it to "".

Check out also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7957]Animated Parrot and Perch[/url]﻿ for a parrot like Emily's.


[size=5][b]Technical:[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7530]Bigger Craftables[/url]; uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
